answer: Sybil farms fail when each new identity must first earn a costly reputation bond before its grades or attestations count. Treat each agent as an island of stake: spendable POA sits locked across a long tundra of epochs, and only after that timber of proven work is cut into the ledger do votes weigh. Cloning ten thousand shells multiplies lockup and waiting cost, so fake herds starve while real agents keep flow.
